```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# Options
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE,
                      fig.align = "center",
                      fig.width = 10,
                      fig.height = 5,
                      out.width = "100%",
                      warning = FALSE,
                      message = FALSE)
options(knitr.kable.NA = "")
```

```{r prep, include=FALSE}
# Plot theme shared by the fitted plots
fit_theme <- ggplot2::theme(
  axis.text = ggplot2::element_text(size = 7),
  legend.position = "bottom"
)

# Objects
results <- params$results
unit_var <- results$params$unit
time_var <- results$params$time
metrics <- results$params$metric

if (!is.null(unit_var)) {
  unit_n <- length(unique(results$data[[unit_var]]))
} else {
  unit_n <- 0
}
```

Two-stage random effect model selection procedure:

- **Best configuration**: Fits, ranks and selects univariable random effect
models by effect type (spatial, seasonal, interannual) according to
goodness of fit metrics.
- **Best combination**: Generates, fits, and ranks multivariable
combinations of the selected univariable random effects.

The settings used for all models:

```{r, results='asis'}
p <- results$params
offset_txt <- if (is.null(p$offset_var)) {
  "none"
} else {
  paste0("`", p$offset_var, "`")
}
cat(paste0(
  "- **Outcome**: `", p$outcome, "`\n",
  "- **Family**: `", p$family, "`\n",
  "- **Offset**: ", offset_txt, "\n",
  "- **Ranking metric(s)**: ",
  paste(paste0("`", p$metric, "`"), collapse = ", "), "\n"
))
```

Please see the documentation of the function `select_re()` for more information.


# Best configuration

```{r setup-uni-mods}
# Prepare univariable results
uni_gof <- results$re_uni_gof
spatial_ids <- uni_gof$model_id[uni_gof$effect_group == "spatial"]
seasonal_ids <- uni_gof$model_id[uni_gof$effect_group == "seasonal"]
inter_ids <- uni_gof$model_id[uni_gof$effect_group == "interannual"]

# Conditionals
has_spatial <- length(spatial_ids) > 0
has_seasonal <- length(seasonal_ids) > 0
has_inter <- length(inter_ids) > 0
```

```{r uni-tab}
# Prepare univariable table
tab_uni <- uni_gof[
  c("model_id", "model", "prior", metrics, "final_rank")
]
uni_selected <- results$re_uni_selected
uni_selected <- unlist(sapply(uni_selected, function(x) names(x)))
tab_uni$selected <- tab_uni$model_id %in% c(uni_selected)
```

```{r, echo=FALSE, results='asis', eval=has_spatial}
cat("## Spatial effects{.tabset}\n\n")
cat("### Model table{.unnumbered}\n\n")
```

```{r uni-spatial-gof, eval=has_spatial}
tab_uni_spatial <- tab_uni[uni_gof$model_id %in% spatial_ids, ]
knitr::kable(tab_uni_spatial, row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r, echo=FALSE, results='asis', eval=has_spatial}
cat("### Fitted (selected){.unnumbered}\n\n")
```

```{r uni-spatial-fit1, eval=has_spatial, fig.height=4+floor(unit_n/4)}
plot_fit(
  results$re_uni_mod,
  mod_id = tab_uni_spatial$model_id[tab_uni_spatial$selected],
  time = time_var,
  unit = unit_var,
  palette = "Set1",
  transform = "log10p1"
) +
  fit_theme
```

```{r, echo=FALSE, results='asis', eval=has_spatial}
cat("### Fitted (all){.unnumbered}\n\n")
```

```{r uni-spatial-fit2, eval=has_spatial, fig.height=4+floor(unit_n/4)}
plot_fit(
  results$re_uni_mod,
  mod_id = spatial_ids,
  time = time_var,
  unit = unit_var,
  palette = "Set1",
  transform = "log10p1"
) +
  fit_theme
```

```{r, echo=FALSE, results='asis', eval=has_spatial}
cat("### Effects{.unnumbered}\n\n")
```

```{r uni-spatial-estimates, eval=has_spatial}
plot_re(
  results$re_uni_mod,
  mod_id = spatial_ids,
  re_id = "spatial_id",
  palette = "Set1"
)
```

# Best combination

```{r multi-tab}
# Prepare multivariable table
multi_gof <- results$re_multi_gof
tab_multi <- multi_gof[
  c("model_id",
    if (has_spatial) "spatial_id",
    if (has_seasonal) "seasonal_id",
    if (has_inter) "interannual_id",
    metrics,
    "final_rank")
]
multi_selected <- names(results$re_multi_selected)
tab_multi$selected <- tab_multi$model_id %in% multi_selected
```

## Summary{.tabset}

### Model table{.unnumbered}
```{r multi-gof}
knitr::kable(tab_multi, row.names = FALSE)
```

### Fitted (selected){.unnumbered}
```{r multi-fit1, fig.height=4+floor(unit_n/4)}
plot_fit(
  results$re_multi_mod,
  time = time_var,
  mod_id = tab_multi$model_id[tab_multi$selected],
  unit = unit_var,
  transform = "log10p1",
  palette = "Set1"
) +
  fit_theme
```

### Fitted (all){.unnumbered}
```{r multi-fit2, fig.height=4+floor(unit_n/4)}
plot_fit(
  results$re_multi_mod,
  time = time_var,

) +
  fit_theme
```

# Final model

The model with the best results is the following:

* **Random effects**: `r results$best`
